title: Private Channel
story: The metrics exporter and its collector share app-net with the public gateway and the api. Security wants their traffic moved to a channel the api cannot reach.
objective: Give exporter and collector a network they share, keep gateway and api connected, and make sure neither exporter nor collector shares a network with api.
hints: docker network create makes a new internal network for this lab.
Connect both services to the new network before disconnecting them from app-net, so they never lose each other.
For example: docker network create metrics-net, connect exporter and collector to it, then disconnect both from app-net.
explanation: Separate networks are the simplest segmentation tool. Moving a pair of services onto a network of their own keeps their traffic private, and connecting before disconnecting keeps them talking throughout the move.
